_comment: One table for the model-id facts each pricing copy derives on its own: hooks/cost-tracker.sh calc_cost, hooks/backfill-cost-events.py calc_cost, scripts/check-pricing-roster.sh find_unpriced_ids and monitor health-detail.ts findUnpricedModelRows. Each copy's suite reads this file, so a copy changed alone fails its suite, and a row changed here fails every copy that disagrees. zero_cost_ids: priced at $0 without a rate lookup, so never reported as lacking a row. rate_lookup_ids: near misses that still need a row. normalized_keys: hooks/lib/pricing_loader.py normalize_model_key.

normalized_keys.name: a plain id is its own key
a context variant is cut at its bracket
a snapshot date suffix is dropped
the bracket is cut before the date is dropped
a seven-digit numeric suffix is kept
a nine-digit numeric suffix is kept
a date inside the id is kept
an id the bracket cut empties keeps its raw form
an id the date drop empties keeps its raw form
